_comment: Every entry here IS a hole: a step gated on the artefact whose absence is
the defect the step exists to catch. They are listed rather than fixed
because each is owned by an in-flight change on the same subsystem, and
silently allowlisting them would recreate exactly the invisibility this
flow_condition_reachability_check.py FAILs on any hole NOT listed here, and
ALSO FAILs when a listed entry is no longer a hole. A fix must therefore
delete its baseline entry in the same change — the file cannot rot into a
Do not add to this file to make a build green. Add to it only with an
owner, and only when the fix genuinely belongs in another change.

holes.owner: vibe-ic#235 — PRODUCER + CONSUMER halves LANDED; flow-YAML wire BLOCKED on a missing non-fatal flow verdict — see note
holes.note: Same shape as DT1 and strictly worse: the condition is ALL-of, so ANY one of the three inputs going missing disarms the step. STATUS (vibe-ic#235): the PRODUCER half is DONE — phase3_one_shot_runner.run_at_speed_atpg_producers writes `phase2/stage2/dft/path_delay_atpg_not_run.json` on every self-disable branch (precondition_unmet / producer_wrote_no_artifact / producer_execution_error) and DELETES it once a real grade exists. The CONSUMER half is DONE — path_delay_coverage_check now reads that record and answers BLOCKED (rc 1, still not a pass) with the recorded reason, instead of a bare FAIL that cannot tell 'never ran' from 'ran and could not measure'. This stays a hole because the REMAINING — and NOT the edit this note previously prescribed. It said to add the disclosure path to condition.files_exist with `any_of: true`, and called that safe because the BLOCKED branch had landed. MEASURED, that edit BREAKS the flow: `flow_compliance_check` has no BLOCKED verdict (its set is PASS/FAIL/MISSING/SKIPPED-CONDITION/SKIPPED-SETUP-REQUIRED/DEFERRED-BY-UPSTREAM/VACUOUS-PASS/WAIVED-DEFERRED) and the consumer returns rc 1 for BLOCKED exactly as it does for FAIL. Arming the condition therefore flips this step from SKIPPED-CONDITION to a hard FAIL on EVERY design that has a cut netlist and has not yet routed — strictly worse than the silent skip it was meant to cure. Closing this entry needs a FLOW-LEVEL non-fatal verdict for 'ran, disclosed, could not measure' first; until that exists the disclosure record is the fix and this entry stays open by design.
